# Security Policy

`utilitycss` is pre-1.0. Security fixes are applied to the latest release line
and, when practical, the current development branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting / Security Advisory form
for this repository. Do not open a public issue, pull request, or discussion for
an unpatched vulnerability. If private reporting is unavailable, contact a
repository maintainer through GitHub and include "private security report" in
the subject.

Reports should include the affected version or commit, reproduction steps, the
smallest useful input or fixture, and the impact. Encrypted attachments MAY be
used when sensitive details are necessary.

## Disclosure process

Maintainers will acknowledge a report within five business days, investigate
with the reporter, and coordinate a fix and disclosure date. A coordinated
advisory will identify affected versions, mitigations, and the fixed release.

Supported versions and release status are documented in the repository's
release notes; pre-1.0 compatibility is not guaranteed between minor versions.
